description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Report on Review of the Balance Sheet of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as at 30th June 2021
categorisation: This gazette contains the Central Bank of Sri Lanka's balance sheet and the Auditor General's review report, which constitutes financial regulatory information and statutory reporting requirements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves official financial reporting, audit standards compliance, and regulatory framework documentation rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
